rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved, Oregon Board-approved or ACCME-accredited programs; cultural competency CPE approved by the Oregon Health Authority (ORS 413.450) or any cultural competency CPE
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than one year before July 1 of the renewal period: only the 2 hours of cultural competency.
rules.audit_note: Track ACPE credit in NABP CPE Monitor; upload Board-approved or ACCME credit to the eGov profile. Keep documentation 6 years. Missing CPE found at audit may lead to discipline.

topics.who: Patient safety or medication error prevention

rules.notes: Applies to Certified Oregon Pharmacy Technicians and Pharmacy Technicians. Licenses expire June 30 of even years; CPE period July 1 – June 30. 6 mandatory hours + 14 other pharmacy hours. Reporting via CPE Monitor / eGov upload.
